title: A Network parent and its chapters list Circles and Journeys with each other like a Collective's member Spaces, and the help copy says Partners is the one Collective tool a Network does not get

source.ref: The Group handoff (2026-10-19) task A4: "Turn on the Partners tab and cross-listing of Journeys and Circles for network, or correct the 'everything Collective does' copy. Both features currently check isCollectivePlan only."

detail: The handoff offered two ways out and this row takes one of each. Cross-listing opens to the Network plan: the four plan checks in lib/collective/cross-listing-store.ts (a listing Space, its parent, the target list and the eligible sources) read isChapterParentPlan, which is collective, nonprofit_collective and network, so a chapter lists a Circle or Journey with the parent or another chapter and the parent lists with a chapter, exactly as a Collective's member Spaces do. The settings page, the actions and the readers that draw accepted listings are plan-blind and needed no change; the target picker's label says Collective, Network or member Space. Partners stays a Collective tool: spacePlanTab's rule that the plan decides one tab (Partners or Network, never both, SCAN-982 owner spec: Collective is many owners, Network is one owner) is unchanged, and the Network help page and the plans page now say so instead of promising everything Collective does. No migration: collective_cross_listings carries no plan.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const s=r('lib/collective/cross-listing-store.ts');if((s.match(/isChapterParentPlan\(/g)||[]).length<6)bad.push('cross-listing still checks the Collective plans by hand');if(/plan\s*===\s*'collective'/.test(s))bad.push('a Collective-only plan literal is back in the store');const p=r('lib/collective/partners.ts');if(!/isCollectivePlan\(space.plan\)\) return 'partners'/.test(p))bad.push('Partners opened past Collective');const h=r('content/help/spaces/network.md');if(!/except Partners/.test(h))bad.push('network help still promises everything Collective does');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-950: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
